summary: Iteration 9 backend verification of two LR PDF changes in build_lr_pdf: (1) 'Freight Basis' and 'Freight Amount' fields removed from LR page 1; (2) 'Unloading Details by Site Officials' and Site Officer signature strip rendered column-wise with proper headers. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter9_lr_pdf.py with 22 pytest cases using PyMuPDF (fitz) to open the returned PDF bytes and assert page structure and text presence/absence. All 22 tests pass. Regression checks confirm: PDF is exactly 2 pages, page 1 still contains LR number, vehicle, driver, waybill, from/to, load details, and page 2 contains only TERMS & CONDITIONS with no operational data leaking.
critical_code_review_comments: pdf_generator.py build_lr_pdf: the un_tbl and sig_tbl create fixed-height empty rows via TOPPADDING (18pt/22pt). Consider using rowHeights= param for explicit control so future style tweaks don't collapse the fillable row.

The empty row cells in un_tbl/sig_tbl are literal empty strings ''; if a future reviewer wants visible ruling lines inside the fillable row for handwriting, add MINPADDING or LINEBELOW styling per cell.
server.py is 2034 lines — still worth splitting into routers (carried over from iter-8).
seed_data_creation: Module-scope fixture creates TEST_iter9_Customer + one TEST trip (LR-TEST-9-001, vehicle TS09LR909); both deleted in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
LR PDF text extraction via PyMuPDF (fitz) works reliably. Note that ReportLab's
inside Paragraphs causes 'Date of
